veranderings.voor: Dit is dieselfde paar as in 'n steenkoolkragstasie
veranderings.na: Dit is dieselfde twee masjiene as in 'n steenkoolkragstasie
veranderings.rede: 'Dieselfde paar' is vague without a noun; both parts are defined as machines in the lesson's own glossary, so naming them adds no content.

veranderings.voor: soms in lang rye op oop veld
veranderings.na: soms in lang rye in die oop veld
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans says 'in die (oop) veld', not 'op oop veld'.
'Amper net so lyk' is the natural idiom for looking nearly the same.

veranderings.voor: maar dit maak water warm en nie elektrisiteit nie
veranderings.na: maar dit maak water warm en maak nie elektrisiteit nie
veranderings.rede: 'Maak warm' and 'maak elektrisiteit' are different constructions, so sharing one verb reads awkwardly; repeating the verb makes the contrast clear.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: solank ons dit nie vinniger gebruik as wat die natuur dit aanvul nie
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the block 'Wat die natuur weer aanvul' the sentence starts 'Hulle raak nie op nie' (the son, wind and water), so the protected 'dit ... dit' disagrees in number with its antecedent; 'hulle ... hulle' would agree. The glossary entry, which starts with 'Dit', is fine. Left unchanged because the wording is protected.
